title: Resolving Thinness of Degree-Six Symplectic Hypergeometric Monodromy Groups
summary: We prove arithmeticity for two degree-six symplectic hypergeometric monodromy groups and thinness for a third case. These are the three open cases called C-32, C-47, and C-55 in the paper [BDN25] by Bajpai--Dona--Nitsche. This hence settles thinness of primitive integral symplectic hypergeometric monodromy groups of degree-six, according to the tabulation by Bajpai--Dona--Singh--Singh [BDSS21].
